1.title: Grammar Auction: have/has + V3
1.stage: Yangi mavzu (have/has + V3) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Present Perfect gaplarida have/has, V3 shakli, been/gone va 'yesterday' bilan bog'liq xatolarni topish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering; har jamoaning boshlang'ich puli — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: have/has to'g'rimi, fe'l V3 shaklidami, vaqt so'zi (yesterday) bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus oladi; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa (masalan: has went → has gone) +50 oladi.
12 gap tugagach, eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: I have lost my phone, so I can't call you.
items.why: lose – lost – lost; natija hozir: telefon yo'q.

items.fix: She has finished her homework.
items.why: He/She/It → has.

items.s: Have you ever eaten Samarkand plov?

items.why: has + V3: go – went – GONE.

items.s: Aziz has broken his arm, so he can't play football.
items.why: break – broke – broken; natija hozir ko'rinadi.

items.s: I have seen this film yesterday.
items.fix: I saw this film yesterday.
items.why: 'yesterday' — vaqt aniq → Past Simple.

items.s: Has Laylo ever ridden a horse?
items.why: Has + Laylo (she) + ever + V3: ride – rode – ridden.

items.s: He has never flew on a plane.
items.fix: He has never flown on a plane.
items.why: has + V3: fly – flew – FLOWN.

items.s: My sister hasn't found her keys yet.
items.why: Inkor: hasn't + V3 (find – found – found).

items.s: Have you ever been in London?
items.fix: Have you ever been to London?
items.why: Borib kelgan joy: been TO.

items.why: They → have; buy – bought – bought.

items.s: Dilnoza isn't here. She has been to the shop.
items.fix: Dilnoza isn't here. She has gone to the shop.

1.title: Board Game: Have you ever…?
1.stage: Sinf mashqlaridan keyin, og'zaki mustahkamlash sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Present Perfect (tasdiq, inkor, savol, qisqa javob), noto'g'ri fe'llarning V2/V3 shakllari va been/gone farqini og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbatdagi o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: shaklni aytadi (buy – bought – bought) yoki to'liq gap tuzadi (I have lost my pen).
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustoz javob kaliti bo'yicha hal qiladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, yana zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

1.title: Dominoes: result now ↔ what has happened
1.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida yoki 2-mashq ('Natija gapi') o'rniga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Hozirgi holatni uning sababi bilan ulash; sabab Present Perfect'da (have/has + V3) — 'natija hozir' qoidasini mustahkamlash.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi holat (masalan: I can't open the front door —) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi sababga ulanishini toping.
Sabab doim Present Perfect'da: have/has + V3 (I have lost my keys). Ega va ma'no mos kelishi shart.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.
Bonus: zanjirdagi har bir V3 fe'lning uchala shaklini aytgan guruh +1 ball oladi (lose – lost – lost).

he has grown a beard.

the boys have hit it with a ball.

1.title: Taboo: irregular verbs (V1–V2–V3)
1.stage: CORE lug'at (hikoya fe'llari, V1–V2–V3) o'rganilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Hikoya fe'llarini (lose, steal, swim, forget…) inglizcha tushuntirish va uchala shaklini (V1–V2–V3) tez eslash.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib kartani oladi va uni jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi.
60 soniya ichida fe'lni inglizcha tushuntiradi: fe'lning o'zi, uning V2/V3 shakllari va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Present Perfect gap bilan tushuntirish mumkin, masalan: 'I have done this with my keys, and now I can't open the door' (lose).
Jamoa fe'lni topsa +1 ball; uchala shaklini to'g'ri aytsa (lose – lost – lost) yana +1 ball.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has been to Samarkand
1.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq yoki warm-up ('What have you done today?') o'rniga (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: 'Have you ever + V3?' savolini o'zi tuzish va 'Yes, I have / No, I haven't' qisqa javoblari bilan gaplashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi: Have you ever + V3 …? (masalan: Have you ever ridden a horse?).
'Yes, I have' degan o'quvchining ismini yozadi; 'No, I haven't' bo'lsa — boshqasidan so'raydi. 'never' qatorida esa 'No, I haven't' degan odam yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani Present Perfect bilan aytadi: 'Aziz has ridden a horse.'

1.title: Speaking cards: things I have done
1.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa bosqichida: 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Tajriba va natija haqida Present Perfect bilan 3–4 gapli og'zaki javob berish (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 ta Present Perfect gap ishlatadi (I have…, I haven't…, I have never…).
Tinglovchi to'g'ri ishlatilgan V3 shakllarini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball. Noto'g'ri shakl (have went) uchun ball yo'q — sherigi tuzatib beradi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

1.title: Sentence Race: Present Perfect sentences
1.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Present Perfect gapida so'z tartibi: ega + have/has (+ never) + V3; savolda Have/Has + ega + ever + V3.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: ega + have/has + V3; savolda Have/Has birinchi keladi.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert olinadi.
Bonus: gapni o'zbekchaga to'g'ri tarjima qilgan jamoa yana +1 ball oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: V1–V2–V3 shakllari, Present Perfect xatolari, fe'l ma'nolari va og'zaki gaplarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq Present Perfect gap bo'lishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

2.title: Grammar Auction: Past Simple or Present Perfect?
2.stage: Yangi mavzu (vaqt aniqmi — natijami?) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
2.goal: Vaqt aniq bo'lsa Past Simple, vaqt aytilmasa yoki tajriba/natija bo'lsa Present Perfect ishlatilishini ajratish; 'was born' va 'When did…?' qoidalari.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering; har jamoaning boshlang'ich puli — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gapda aniq vaqt bormi (yesterday, ago, last…, in 2009) yoki tajriba/natija (ever, yet, so far)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus oladi; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa (masalan: have been born → was born) +50 oladi.
12 gap tugagach, eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

2.title: Dominoes: Have you ever…? → When did you…?
2.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida yoki 4-mashq ('Suhbat: tajriba → tafsilot') o'rniga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
2.goal: Savol (Present Perfect: tajriba/natija) → javob-tafsilot (Past Simple + aniq vaqt) qolipini mustahkamlash; V3 → V2 shakllarini tanish.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: o'ng tomondagi savolga mos javobni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.

Qoida: ko'p savollar Present Perfect'da (Have you ever…? / Has…yet?), javobi Past Simple'da aniq vaqt bilan; 'When…?' savollari va javoblari ikkalasi ham Past Simple. Fe'lga qarang: held – held, been – went, seen – saw.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni dialog qilib o'qiydi (biri savol beradi, biri javob beradi); ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

60 soniya ichida so'zni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

3.title: Grammar Auction: since, for, because + Present Perfect
3.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (since/for/How long/because) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
3.goal: since (boshlanish nuqtasi) va for (davr) ni to'g'ri tanlash, How long + have/has + V3 savoli va because + Present Perfect gaplaridagi xatoni topib tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: since yoki for to'g'ri tanlanganmi, fe'l have/has + V3 shaklidami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus oladi. XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'rilagan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'since three years' → 'for three years').
12 gap tugagach, eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi yarim gapga qaysi toshning chap tomoni mos kelishini toping.

4.title: Grammar Auction: yet, still, already, just
4.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (yet/still/already/just) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
4.goal: yet (gap oxirida), still (haven't/hasn't dan oldin), already va just (have/has bilan V3 orasida) o'rnini va have/has + V3 shaklini tekshirib, xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: yet/still/already/just to'g'ri joydami, fe'l V3 shaklidami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus oladi. XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'rilagan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'She hasn't still called' → 'She still hasn't called').
12 gap tugagach, eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

4.title: Board Game: Have you done it yet?
4.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin og'zaki mustahkamlash sifatida yoki 5-dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
4.goal: yet/still/already/just ni gapning to'g'ri joyiga qo'yish, yet bilan savol berish va ta'ziya iboralarini (pass away, I'm sorry for your loss) og'zaki ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gapni ovoz chiqarib aytadi.

Guruh a'zolari javob kalitiga qarab tekshiradi (kalit varag'i guruh sardorida): yet — oxirida, still — haven't dan oldin, already/just — have va V3 orasida. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

4.title: Dominoes: Have you… yet? — Yes, I've already…
4.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida (formula → gap) yoki sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
4.goal: yet bilan berilgan savolga already / just / still / not … yet bilan mos javobni topish va savol-javobni ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi javob mos kelishini toping.
Mos kelish belgilari: savoldagi fe'l javobda qaytariladi (seen → seen), olmosh mos keladi (your parents → they), Yes/No savolga Yes/No bilan javob beriladi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh savol-javoblarni rollarda o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

4.title: Taboo: loss and remembrance (with respect)
4.stage: 'Death — CORE 20' lug'at bosqichidan keyin, hurmat ohangida (10 daqiqa)
4.goal: O'lim va motam mavzusidagi so'zlarni (funeral, widow, orphan, will, condolences…) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan hurmat bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Boshlashdan oldin ustoz eslatadi: mavzu og'ir — hazil va kulgi qilinmaydi, so'zlar hurmat bilan tushuntiriladi.
Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, orphan uchun: 'A boy or a girl. His or her mother and father have passed away.').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi karta olinadi. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.title: Find someone who… has already chosen a university
4.stage: Kirish savolidan keyin ('Have you done your homework?') yoki dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
4.goal: Have you + V3 … yet? savolini tuzish va already / just / not … yet / still haven't bilan javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi. Diqqat: jadvalda 'already' yoki 'still' bo'lsa ham, savol 'yet' bilan tuziladi (Have you chosen a university yet?).
Javob to'liq bo'lishi shart: 'Yes, I've already…' yoki 'No, I haven't … yet'. Mos javob bergan odamning ismi yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytadi (masalan: Lola has already chosen a university).

4.goal: yet/still/already/just ishlatib 3–4 gapli javob berish; xotira, meros (legacy), ta'ziya mavzusida hurmat bilan gapirish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va yet, still, already yoki just dan kamida bittasini ishlatadi.

Shaxsiy yo'qotish haqida gapirish majburiy emas — o'quvchi 'Pass' deb boshqa karta olishi mumkin.

5.title: Grammar Auction: have/has been + V-ing
5.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish: been + V-ing, has/have tanlash, since/for, holat fe'li (know).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? (has/have, been + V-ing, since/for, know kabi fe'llarni tekshiring).
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI chiqsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO chiqsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'They have been played' → 'They have been playing').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.why: Iz ko'rinadi: charchagan ko'z — uzoq davom etgan ish sababi (PPC).

items.why: since bilan Present Continuous emas → has been + V-ing.

items.fix: They have been playing football for two hours.
items.why: been + V-ing bo'ladi, V3 (played) emas.

5.title: Board Game: What have you been doing?

Tana a'zolarini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lgan katakda o'yinchi o'sha joyni qo'li bilan ko'rsatib, inglizcha nomini aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

5.title: Dominoes: Why? Because … has been + V-ing
5.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — 'Iz (natija ko'rinadi)' qolipini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Ko'rinib turgan natija (tana a'zosi og'riyapti, charchagan) va uning sababini PPC bilan ulash: '… because he has been running.' — olmosh va has/have mosligi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (masalan: 'Aziz is out of breath because') qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi sabab bilan ulanishini toping.

Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; gapni o'zbekchaga to'g'ri tarjima qilsa yana +1.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Forms, Correct it, Body parts, Say it!) va har birida 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Body parts 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi, jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.

Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: Grammar Auction: I've bought / I've been shopping
6.stage: Yangi mavzu (natija — jarayon jadvali)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Present Perfect (natija, son — how many, holat fe'llari) va Present Perfect Continuous (jarayon, davomiylik — how long) farqini ko'rish va xato gapni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: natija yoki son (three, how many) — PP; davomiylik (for an hour, all day) — PPC (been + V-ing); have = ega bo'lmoq — faqat PP.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI chiqsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO chiqsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri zamonga o'tkazgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'I've been having this coat' → 'I've had this coat').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

6.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'PP yoki PPC — tanlang' mashqidan keyin (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: PP (natija, how many) va PPC (jarayon, how long) ni tanlab og'zaki gap tuzish; kiyim-kechak so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

6.title: Dominoes: How many? How long? Result or process
6.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — How many / How long juftlarini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Savol va javobni, natija va sababni ulash: How many? → PP (She's tried on six), How long? → PPC (She's been doing it for an hour); olmosh va zamon mosligi.

7.title: Grammar Auction: taller, more beautiful, as tall as
7.stage: YANGI MAVZU (comparative) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
7.goal: Comparative shakllari (-er / more / as … as) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilganini ajrata olish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

7.title: Dominoes: -er than / more … than / as … as
7.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqlari boshida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
7.goal: Gap boshini grammatik va mantiqan to'g'ri davom bilan ulash: -er than, more + sifat + than, (not) as + sifat + as, much + -er.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomoniga ulanadi — toping.
Maslahat: 'more' dan keyin -er li sifat kelmaydi; 'as' dan keyin 'than' kelmaydi; 'is' dan keyin darhol 'than' kelmaydi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz javoblar varag'i bilan tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

8.title: Dominoes: He is the most…
8.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida: 1–3-mashqlardan keyin, 'Xarakter: kim eng…?' mashqidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang.
8.goal: Xarakterni tasvirlovchi gapni mos superlative davomi bilan ulash: 'the' dan keyin -est shakli (the funniest), 'the most' dan keyin uzun sifat (the most honest).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap (masalan: 'Sardor tells jokes all day. He is the') qaysi toshning chap tomoni bilan davom etishini toping.
Maslahat: 'the' bilan tugagan gapga -est shakl (funniest, shyest), 'the most' bilan tugaganiga uzun sifat (honest, generous) ulanadi; ma'no va he/she ham mos bo'lsin.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

8.title: Taboo: character adjectives
8.stage: Character (CORE 20) lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida normativdan oldin.
8.goal: Xarakter sifatlarini (kind, honest, punctual, stubborn, stingy …) so'zning o'zini aytmasdan inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida sifatni inglizcha tushuntiradi: so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi qolip: 'This person always / never … . For example, my grandmother is like this.' Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha — mumkin emas.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus: topilgan so'z bilan superlative gap aytgan jamoa yana +1 oladi (masalan: My aunt is the most generous person in our family).
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

8.title: Find someone who… is the oldest child
8.stage: Dars boshida warm-up ('Who is the tallest?' savoli o'rniga) yoki Reading'dan oldin harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa).
8.goal: Superlative bilan savol tuzish va javob berish: 'Are you the oldest child in your family?', 'Do you think … is the most … ?'
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Are you the youngest person in your family?').
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why do you think so?).
Savolda 'the' tushib qolsa yoki shakl xato bo'lsa (the most tall) — javob hisoblanmaydi, savol qayta beriladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani superlative gaplar bilan aytadi (Aziz is the oldest child in his family).

9.title: Grammar Auction: had gone, had taken
9.stage: Yangi mavzu (Past Perfect) va Kombinatsiyadan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: Past Perfect (had + V3) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish: had + V3 shakli (had gone, had taken), oldingi ish uchun had, qisqa javob 'Yes, I had'.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: qaysi ish OLDIN bo'lgan va unda had + V3 to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa (masalan: 'had went' → 'had gone') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: By the time the ambulance arrived, the pain had stopped.
items.why: Og'riq tez yordamdan OLDIN to'xtagan → had + V3 (had stopped).

items.fix: She had gone to the doctor before she came to school.
items.why: had + V3: go → went → gone.

items.s: I felt better because I had taken the medicine.
items.why: Sabab (dori ichish) oldin bo'lgan → because + had + V3.

items.why: Had bilan berilgan savolga qisqa javob ham had bilan: Yes, I had.

items.why: had never + V3 + before (break → broke → broken).

items.why: had + V3: recover → recovered (-ed kerak).

items.fix: Had she taken her temperature before she called the doctor?
items.why: Savolda ham had + V3: take → took → taken.

items.why: Shamollash oldin bo'lgan → had caught (catch → caught → caught).

items.fix: Before the doctor came, my mother had given me some water.

9.title: Board Game: What had happened?
9.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Vaqt chizig'i' mashqidan keyin (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: V3 shakllarini aytish, Past Perfect tasdiq / inkor / savol tuzish, qaysi ish oldin bo'lganini aniqlash va sog'liq mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbatdagi o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: V3 ni aytadi yoki had + V3 bilan to'liq gap tuzadi.
'Which happened first?' katagida o'yinchi qaysi ish oldin bo'lganini aytadi va tushuntiradi: had + V3 — oldingi ish.
Guruh tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa javoblar varag'iga qaraladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

9.title: Dominoes: because / by the time + had + V3
9.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Past Simple yoki Past Perfect' mashqidan keyin (12 daqiqa).
9.goal: Oldingi ish (had + V3) va keyingi ish (Past Simple) qismlarini mantiqan ulash; 'Had …?' savoliga mos qisqa javobni (Yes, I had / No, he hadn't) topish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (masalan: 'Madina couldn't sing at the concert because') qaysi toshning chap tomoni bilan davom etishini toping.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani aytadi (Aziz had learned to swim before he was ten).

9.stage: 'Shifokorda — hikoya' mashqi o'rniga yoki Writing / speaking mini-vazifa bosqichida (12 daqiqa).
9.goal: Sog'liq mavzusida Past Perfect (had + V3) va Past Simple'ni birga ishlatib 3–4 gapli javob yoki qisqa hikoya aytish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi: kamida 1 ta Past Perfect (had + V3) va 1 ta Past Simple gap bo'lishi shart.
Tinglovchi to'g'ri Past Perfect gaplarni va sog'liq so'zlarini (cough, fever, recover …) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; 'had went' kabi xato — ball yo'q.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; eng qiziq hikoya sinfga aytiladi.

9.title: Sentence Race: Past Perfect sentences
9.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: Past Perfect gapda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: S + had (never / already) + V3; Had + S + V3 …?; by the time / because / after bilan.
rules: Kesilgan so'zlarni gap bo'yicha konvertlarga soling; har jamoaga bittadan konvert bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri, nuqta yoki '?' — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va qaysi ish OLDIN bo'lganini aytadi; so'ng konvertni keyingi jamoa bilan almashtiradi.
Hamma konvertlar aylanib chiqqanda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Health 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq Past Perfect gap bo'lishi kerak.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ballni oladi).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

10.title: Grammar Auction: will have + V3
10.stage: Yangi mavzu (Future Perfect) tushuntirilgandan keyin, CORE lug'atdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
10.goal: Future Perfect (will have + V3 / won't have + V3 / Will … have + V3?) va 'by the time + Present Simple' dagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: 'will have + V3' va 'by the time' dan keyingi zamon to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni sotib olish uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'will has' → 'will have', 'will have finish' → 'will have finished').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: By Friday, I will have finished all my exams — what a relief!
items.why: Kelajak nuqtagacha tugagan ish: by + vaqt, will have + V3.

items.why: Ertagacha tugagan o'zgarish: will have + V3 (calmed down).

items.fix: I will have finished my project by Monday.
items.why: have dan keyin V3 kerak: finished (finish emas).

items.s: The football match won't have finished by 9 pm.
items.why: Inkor: won't have + V3.

items.s: Will you have been finished your homework by 8 pm?
items.fix: Will you have finished your homework by 8 pm?
items.why: Savol: Will + S + have + V3 — 'been' ortiqcha.

items.s: Next year my parents will have been married for 20 years.
items.why: be → been: will have been + for + davr.

items.s: By 2028, my sister will have became a doctor.
items.fix: By 2028, my sister will have become a doctor.
items.why: become: V2 — became, V3 — become. will have + V3.

items.why: Taxmin: hozirgacha tugagan bo'lsa kerak → will have + V3.

10.title: Board Game: By 2030 I will have…
10.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichi o'rniga yoki sinf mashqlaridan keyin gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang

rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga bitta taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbatdagi o'quvchi zar tashlaydi va tushgan katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi. Gap tuzish, tuzatish va gapirish topshiriqlarida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi kerak (masalan: 'By 2030, I will have…').

FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

10.title: Dominoes: Future Perfect sentence halves
10.stage: Sinf mashqlari boshida — 'will have + V3' ni mustahkamlash uchun (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
10.goal: Future Perfect gap qismlarini grammatik va mantiqan ulash; his-tuyg'u so'zlari (furious, relieved, worried, excited, sad) kontekstida.
rules: Har guruhga qirqilgan va aralashtirilgan bitta domino to'plamini bering.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng yarmidagi gap boshini qaysi toshning chap yarmi davom ettiradi — shuni topib ulang.
Davom grammatik (will have + V3, by the time + Present Simple) va mantiqan mos bo'lishi kerak: masalan, 'the tired baby will have' → 'fallen asleep by now'.
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Tugatgan guruh qo'l ko'taradi va butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Ustoz kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi: xato bo'lsa — guruh tuzatishga qaytadi. Birinchi to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

10.stage: Feelings and emotions (CORE 20) lug'atidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
10.goal: Feelings and emotions lug'atidagi sifatlarni (nervous, relieved, jealous, grateful…) inglizcha vaziyat va ta'rif orqali tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling; kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying.
Jamoadan bir o'quvchi karta olib, 60 soniyada his-tuyg'u so'zini inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Vaziyat aytish yaxshi yordam beradi: 'You feel this when your last exam is over…' yoki 'By Friday you will have… and you feel…'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Mimika va imo-ishora mumkin. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

10.title: Find someone who… will have finished school by 2028
10.stage: Kirish savoli ('By 2030 I will have…') davomi yoki sinf mashqlari orasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
10.goal: 'Will you have + V3 … by …?' savolini o'zi tuzish va javob berish; qo'shimcha savolda his-tuyg'u so'zini ishlatish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi: 'Will you have + V3 … by …?' (masalan: Will you have finished school by 2028?).

'Yes' deb javob bergan ('Yes, I will' / 'Yes, I do') odamning ismini yozadi; 'won't' qatorida — 'No, I won't' degan odamni. Keyin qo'shimcha savol: 'How will you feel then?' — javobda his-tuyg'u so'zi bo'lsin.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani aytadi: 'Aziz will have finished school by 2028. He will feel proud.'

10.goal: Kelajak rejalari haqida Future Perfect bilan va his-tuyg'ular haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi).
rules: Juftliklarga karta dastasini teskari qilib bering.
A o'quvchi karta olib savolni o'qiydi; B kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi.
Kelajak kartalarida javobda kamida 1 ta Future Perfect gap (will have + V3) bo'lsin; his-tuyg'u kartalarida — kamida 2 ta his-tuyg'u so'zi (excited, nervous, proud, relieved…).

10.title: Sentence Race: Future Perfect
10.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
10.goal: Future Perfect gaplarda so'z tartibi: will + have + V3, by + vaqt, by the time + Present Simple, savol va inkor.
rules: Gaplarni qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Maslahat: 'will' dan keyin 'have', undan keyin V3 (savolda: Will + ega + have + V3); vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri; nuqta yoki '?' li so'z — gap oxiri.

Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.goal: before / after / by the time / as soon as / since dan keyin to'g'ri zamonni tanlash va millat nomlari bosh harf bilan yozilishini tekshirish; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

11.title: Board Game: Around the world with time linkers
11.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichi o'rniga yoki sinf mashqlaridan keyin (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: Ikki gapni before / after / as soon as / by the time bilan qo'shish, since va for ni farqlash, mamlakat ↔ millat juftlarini og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: 3–4 o'quvchiga bitta taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Zar tashlagan o'quvchi katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: millatni aytadi, ikki gapni bog'lovchi bilan qo'shadi yoki xatoni tuzatadi. Qo'shish, tuzatish va gapirish topshiriqlarida javob — to'liq gap.
Guruhdagi bitta 'hakam' javoblar kalitidan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'quvchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
Maxsus kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga yurish, orqaga qaytish, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

11.title: Dominoes: time linkers and nationalities
11.stage: Sinf mashqlari boshida — 'Bog'lovchini tanlang' mashqidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: Bog'lovchili gap qismlarini zamon mosligi (after + had V3, by the time + Present Simple, since + Past Simple…) va mamlakat–millat mantig'i bo'yicha ulash.
rules: Har guruhga qirqilgan va aralashtirilgan bitta domino to'plamini bering.
START toshidan boshlang: o'ng yarmidagi gap boshining davomini boshqa toshning chap yarmidan toping va ulang.

Tekshiruv: bog'lovchi va zamon mos kelishi kerak (After + had V3 → Past Simple; By the time + Present Simple → will have V3; as soon as + Present Simple → will) va mamlakat–millat mantiqan to'g'ri bo'lsin (Japan → sushi).
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugaydi. Tugatgan guruh qo'l ko'taradi va butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Ustoz kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi; xato bo'lsa guruh tuzatadi. Birinchi to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

11.title: Taboo: countries and nationalities
11.stage: Countries and nationalities (CORE 20) lug'atidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: Mamlakatlar va sayohat so'zlarini (passport, border, foreigner, bilingual) inglizcha tushuntirish; topilgan mamlakatning millatini aytish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling; kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying.
Jamoadan bir o'quvchi karta olib, 60 soniyada mamlakat yoki so'zni inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi, uning millat shakli (Italy → Italian) va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus +1: tushuntirishda bog'lovchi ishlatilsa (masalan: 'As soon as you arrive there, you see the pyramids').
Mamlakat topilgach jamoa millatini ham to'g'ri aytsa yana +1 (Japan → Japanese). Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.title: Find someone who… has been abroad since 2020
11.stage: Sinf mashqlari orasida harakatli mashq — since / before / as soon as savollari (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: since / before / as soon as / by the time bilan to'g'ri zamonda savol tuzish (Have you… since…? Had you… before…? Will you… as soon as…?) va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turib sinfda yuradi.
Har qator uchun savolni o'quvchi o'zi tuzadi; zamon bog'lovchiga mos bo'lsin (Have you … since …? / Had you … before …? / Will you … as soon as …?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va qo'shimcha savol beradi: 'When?', 'Where?' yoki 'Which country?'.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani gap bilan aytadi: 'Lola had tried sushi before she was 15.'

11.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa o'rniga — 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javoblar (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: Sayohat, mamlakatlar va o'z hayoti haqida before / after / as soon as / since / by the time bilan 3–4 gapli javob berish (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi).
rules: Juftliklarga karta dastasini teskari qilib bering.
A kartani olib savolni o'qiydi; B kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi.
Javobda kamida 1 ta bog'lovchi (before / after / by the time / as soon as / since) va 1 ta mamlakat yoki millat so'zi bo'lishi shart.
A ball beradi: bog'lovchi to'g'ri zamon bilan +1, mamlakat/millat so'zi +1, STRONG/SUPER so'z +1.
Rollar almashadi; vaqt tugaganda eng ko'p ball to'plagan o'quvchi g'olib.

11.title: Sentence Race: before / after / as soon as / since
11.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
11.goal: Bog'lovchili qo'shma gapda so'z tartibi va zamonlar mosligi (before, after, by the time, as soon as, since).
rules: Gaplarni qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z (ism, joy nomi, millat va 'I' dan tashqari) — gap boshi; vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri; nuqta yoki '?' li so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashadi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi bog'lovchi va zamonlarni aytib bersa (masalan: 'after + Past Perfect, keyin Past Simple').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

After she had finished school, she moved to Korea.

12.title: Grammar Auction: had been raining, had been waiting
12.stage: Yangi mavzu (had been + V-ing) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish: been + V-ing, had/have, for/since, holat fe'li (know).
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: 'had been + V-ing' to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'had been wait' → 'had been waiting', 'since three hours' → 'for three hours').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

items.s: It had been raining in Tashkent for three days when the sun finally came out.
items.why: O'tgan nuqtagacha (the sun came out) davom etgan jarayon: had been + raining + for.

items.s: They had been wait at the bus stop for twenty minutes when it started to rain.
items.fix: They had been waiting at the bus stop for twenty minutes when it started to rain.
items.why: been dan keyin fe'l -ing bilan keladi: waiting.

items.s: The roads were white because it had been snowing all night.
items.why: O'tgandagi iz (roads were white) → sabab: had been snowing.

items.s: I had been knowing about the storm for days.
items.fix: I had known about the storm for days.
items.why: know — holat fe'li, continuous bo'lmaydi: had known.

items.s: How long had you been waiting when the bus finally came?
items.why: Savol: How long + had + you + been + V-ing? (o'tgan nuqta — when the bus came).

items.s: How long have you been waiting for a taxi when the rain started?
items.fix: How long had you been waiting for a taxi when the rain started?
items.why: O'tgan nuqta (when the rain started) → have emas, had.

items.s: Her face was red because she had been sitting in the sun.
items.why: Natija o'tgan zamonda (was red), sababi — davomli jarayon: had been sitting.

items.s: It had been snowing since three hours when we got home.
items.fix: It had been snowing for three hours when we got home.
items.why: three hours — davr, shuning uchun for; since faqat boshlanish nuqtasi bilan.

items.s: We hadn't been walking for long when the storm started.
items.why: Inkor: hadn't been + V-ing (walking).

items.s: The ground was wet because it has been raining.
items.fix: The ground was wet because it had been raining.
items.why: Natija o'tgan zamonda (was wet) → has emas, had been.

items.s: It had been getting colder all week, so we took out our winter coats.
items.why: Bir hafta davom etgan jarayon (getting colder) → had been + V-ing; natija — Past Simple.

items.s: We had being playing football for an hour when it started to hail.
items.fix: We had been playing football for an hour when it started to hail.
items.why: had dan keyin being emas, been: had been playing.

12.title: Dominoes: Had it been raining? Why were the streets white?
12.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida (Weather lug'atidan keyin): savol-javobni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Past Perfect Continuous savollariga mos javobni topish: Had + S + been + V-ing? → Yes, it had / No, I hadn't; Why…? → Because … had been + V-ing.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini aralashtirib bering.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savol yoki gap boshiga mos javobni boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan qidiring.
Moslikni ikki jihatdan tekshiring: grammatika (Had it…? → Yes, it had; Lola → she; Aziz → he; you → I) va ma'no (ko'chalar oq — qor yog'gan).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Tugatgan guruh qo'l ko'taradi va butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulanish bo'lsa, navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. Birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

12.title: Taboo: weather words
12.stage: Weather CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin, kombinatsiyadan oldin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Ob-havo so'zlarini (sunny, foggy, humid, forecast, drought, blizzard…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish: ta'rif, misol, qarama-qarshi so'z.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (kartani jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa so'zni topsa +1 ball va keyingi karta. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda 'had been + V-ing' bilan gap aytsa (masalan: 'I had been standing outside in January without gloves' — freezing) — yana +1.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Board Game: It had been raining all day
12.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Past Perfect Continuous shakllari (tasdiq, inkor, savol, How long, sabab-iz) va ob-havo so'zlari bilan og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga bitta taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Javoblar varag'ini guruh sardori ushlab turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi, fishkasini yurgizadi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gapni ovoz chiqarib aytadi.
Sardor javobni kalit bilan solishtiradi ('e.g.' — namuna, boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi). Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi. 'had been' dan keyin V-ing unutilsa ham xato hisoblanadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

12.title: Find someone who… had been sleeping when the thunder started
12.stage: Dars o'rtasida, Reading oldidan harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Past Perfect Continuous bilan savol tuzish (Had you been + V-ing …?) va qisqa javob berish (Yes, I had / No, I hadn't).
rules: Har o'quvchiga 'Find someone who…' varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzadi: Had you been + V-ing …? (masalan: Had you been living in another city before you moved here?).
'Yes, I had' degan o'quvchining ismini yozadi va qo'shimcha savol beradi: How long had you been …?
'No, I hadn't' bo'lsa — boshqa o'quvchiga o'tadi. Bitta ism varaqda ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
8 qatorni birinchi to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani to'liq gap bilan aytadi: 'Aziz had been sleeping when the last thunderstorm started.'
Ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi; savol noto'g'ri tuzilgan qator hisobga olinmaydi.

12.title: Sentence Race: had been + V-ing
12.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash bosqichida tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi; tanlanmasa — uyga vazifadan oldin.
12.goal: Past Perfect Continuous gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: S + had been + V-ing; Had + S + been + V-ing?; How long had…?
rules: Sinfni 3–4 kishilik jamoalarga bo'ling; har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Yordam: gap boshidagi so'z katta harf bilan (ismlar va 'I' ham katta harfli), nuqta yoki so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz 'had been + V-ing' tartibini tekshiradi.
To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert; gapni o'zbekchaga to'g'ri tarjima qilsa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Forms, Correct it, Weather, Say it!), har birida 100–500 ball.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Weather 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri javob — ball jamoaga. Xato bo'lsa, boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida to'liq gap aytilishi shart; 'e.g.' — namuna javob, boshqa to'g'ri gap ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

13.title: Grammar Auction: will have been studying + revision 7–12
13.stage: Yangi mavzu (will have been + V-ing) va 6 perfect zamon jadvalidan keyin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
13.goal: Future Perfect Continuous va 7–12-darslar grammatikasidagi (comparative, superlative, Past Perfect, Future Perfect, as soon as / by the time, PPC) xatolarni topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zamon va shakl to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'will have been live' → 'will have been living', 'By the time you will come' → 'By the time you come').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

13.title: Dominoes: perfect tenses and comparisons (lessons 7–13)
13.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida, 7–12-darslar grammatikasini takrorlash uchun (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
13.goal: Gap boshini grammatik va mantiqiy mos davom bilan ulash: will have been + V-ing, had + V3, will have + V3, had been + V-ing, -er than, as … as, the -est, as soon as, yet, ever since.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini aralashtirib bering.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshiga mos davomni boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping.
Asosiy maslahat: vaqt ifodasi zamonni ko'rsatadi (By next June → will have been; When I got… → had + V3; By the time you come → will have + V3).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har gapning zamonini aytadi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulanish bo'lsa, navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. Birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tugatgan guruh g'olib.

13.title: Taboo: time words and revision words (lessons 7–13)
13.stage: Revision lug'atidan (vaqt ifodalari + 7–12-darslar so'zlari) keyin, kombinatsiyadan oldin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
13.goal: Vaqt ifodalari (at last, for ages, twice), perfect zamon so'zlari (achievement, career, retire) va 7–11-darslar so'zlarini (abroad, stubborn, prescription…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball va keyingi karta. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda perfect zamonli gap ishlatsa (masalan: 'I haven't seen my cousin since 2015' — for ages) — yana +1.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

13.title: Board Game: By 2030 I will have been…
13.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin — 7–13-darslar bo'yicha umumiy takror (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
13.goal: Future Perfect Continuous hamda 7–12-darslar grammatikasini (comparative, superlative, Past Perfect, Future Perfect, PPC, as soon as / by the time) va vaqt ifodalarini og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga bitta taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Javoblar varag'i guruh sardorida turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi, fishkasini yurgizadi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gapni ovoz chiqarib aytadi.
Sardor javobni kalit bilan solishtiradi ('e.g.' — namuna, boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi). Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

13.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash bosqichida tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi; tanlanmasa — uyga vazifadan oldin.
13.goal: Future Perfect Continuous va 7–12-darslar grammatikasida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: will have been + V-ing, had + V3, had been + V-ing, -er than, the most.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 kishilik jamoalarga bo'ling; har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Yordam: gap boshidagi so'z katta harf bilan (ismlar va 'I' ham katta harfli), nuqta yoki so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi, gapni o'qiydi va zamon yoki grammatika nomini aytadi (masalan: Future Perfect Continuous, comparative).
Gap va nom to'g'ri bo'lsa +2 ball, faqat gap to'g'ri bo'lsa +1; keyin jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

'Say it!' savollarida to'liq gap aytilishi shart; 'e.g.' — namuna javob, boshqa to'g'ri gap ham qabul qilinadi.

14.title: Grammar Auction: Did he steal…? Who stole…?
14.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: Umumiy va maxsus savollarda yordamchi fe'l (do/does/did, is/are/was, have/has, will), so'z tartibi va ega savoli (Who stole…?) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz savolni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: savol to'g'ri tuzilganmi yoki xato?
Jamoalar savolni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa savolni oladi.
Savol TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato savolni birinchi bo'lib to'g'rilagan jamoa +50 oladi: yordamchini egadan oldinga chiqaradi, did/does dan keyin V1 qo'yadi yoki ega savolidan did ni olib tashlaydi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI savol sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.why: Past Continuous: Wh + was + ega + V-ing.

items.fix: Who stole my phone?
items.why: Ega savoli (Who = ega) — did kerak emas: Who + V2 (stole).

items.s: Who are you waiting for?
items.why: Predlogli savol: predlog (for) gap oxirida qoladi.

items.s: Does the suspect has an alibi?
items.fix: Does the suspect have an alibi?
items.why: does dan keyin V1: have (has emas).

14.goal: Darak gapni umumiy (Yes/No) yoki maxsus (Wh-) savolga aylantirish, xato savolni tuzatish va jinoyat mavzusida og'zaki savol berish.

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: darak gapdan savol tuzadi, xato savolni tuzatadi yoki sherigiga savol beradi.

FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

14.title: Dominoes: crime questions and answers
14.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: Savolni mos javob bilan ulash: qisqa javob yordamchi fe'lga mos (Did…? — … did/didn't), maxsus savol javobi savol so'ziga mos (Where? — joy, When? — vaqt, How many? — son).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi javob mos kelishini toping.
Maslahat: Are you…? — I'm / I'm not; Does…? — does; Did…? — did/didn't; Have…? — have; Was…? — was; Will…? — will. Wh-savolga qisqa Yes/No javob berilmaydi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni rolda o'qiydi (biri so'raydi, biri javob beradi); ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Two bottles of perfume.

For six months.

I'm waiting for my lawyer.

14.goal: Jinoyat mavzusidagi so'zlarni (thief, burglar, witness, evidence…) inglizcha tushuntirish; jamoa javobni umumiy savol shaklida aytadi: 'Is it a burglar?'
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa javobni savol bilan aytadi: 'Is it a burglar?' yoki 'Is the word arrest?' Tushuntiruvchi 'Yes, it is.' / 'No, it isn't.' deb javob beradi.
To'g'ri topilsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

14.goal: Turli zamonlarda umumiy savol tuzish (Do/Did/Have/Were/Will you…?) va 'Yes' javobidan keyin maxsus savol berish (When? Where? What happened?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qatordagi gapdan savolni o'zi tuzadi va zamonga mos yordamchini tanlaydi (masalan: '…lost his/her phone last year' → 'Did you lose your phone last year?').
'Yes' degan sinfdoshning ismini yozadi va unga bitta maxsus savol beradi (When? Where? What happened?); javobni qisqa yozib oladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 natijani sinfga aytib beradi.

15.title: Grammar Auction: If I had… / If I had had…

15.goal: Type 2 (If + Past Simple, would + V1) va Type 3 (If + Past Perfect, would have + V3) shakllari to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish; if-qismida would ishlatmaslik.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Avval Type 2 yoki Type 3 ekanini aniqlashadi.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'rilagan jamoa +50 oladi: if-qismidagi would'ni olib tashlaydi, would have + V3 yoki had + V3 shaklini to'g'rilaydi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

15.title: Board Game: What would you do if…?
15.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, juftlikdagi speaking qismi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Type 2 va Type 3 gaplarni og'zaki tuzish: fe'lni to'g'ri shaklga qo'yish, V3 shakllarini aytish, xatoni tuzatish va sayohat haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni tugatadi, fe'lni qavsdan to'g'ri shaklga qo'yadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki savolga javob beradi.
Javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi. Hozirgi xayoliy holat — If + Past Simple, would + V1; o'tgan holat — If + had + V3, would have + V3.
Guruh tekshiradi (shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

15.title: Dominoes: real situation → if-sentence
15.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Real holatni mos xayoliy gap bilan ulash: HOZIRGI holat (don't have, is raining, isn't here) → Type 2 (If + Past Simple, would + V1); O'TGAN holat (didn't buy, rained last Sunday, was full) → Type 3 (If + had + V3, would have + V3).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida real holat yozilgan (masalan: 'We set off late.'). Unga mos if-gapni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.

Diqqat, o'xshash juftliklar bor (tomorrow's / last Friday's train; raining now / rained last Sunday)! Hozirgi holat — If + Past Simple, would + V1; o'tgan holat — If + had + V3, would have + V3. Vaqt so'zlariga qarang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

15.title: Taboo: travelling
15.stage: Travelling — CORE 20 lug'ati o'rgatilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Sayohat so'zlarini (luggage, souvenir, visa, destination, check in…) inglizcha tushuntirish; tushuntirishda Type 2 qolipidan foydalanish: 'If you went to London, you would need this.'
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Har kartada kamida bitta if-gap aytilsa +1 bonus ball (masalan: 'If you lost it, you couldn't fly home.').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

15.title: Find someone who… would travel to Japan
15.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Type 2 (Would you … if you …?) va Type 3 (Would you have … if you had …?) savollarini tuzish va qisqa javob berish (Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qatordagi gapdan savolni o'zi tuzadi (masalan: '…would live abroad if he/she had the chance' → 'Would you live abroad if you had the chance?').
Javob qisqa bo'ladi: 'Yes, I would.' / 'No, I wouldn't.' (Type 3 savolda: 'Yes, I would have.' / 'No, I wouldn't have.'). 'Yes' degan sinfdoshning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' deb so'raydi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni if-gap bilan aytib beradi: 'Aziza would live abroad if she had the chance.'

15.title: Speaking cards: If you could travel…
15.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa bosqichida, 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob o'rniga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Sayohat mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; javobda Type 2 (I would …) yoki Type 3 (I would have …) gaplarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi: savol Type 2 bo'lsa — 'I would …', Type 3 bo'lsa — 'I would have …' bilan.
Tinglovchi to'g'ri if-gaplar va would-gaplarni sanaydi: har biri +1 ball. Xato shakl (If I would…, would have went) — ball yo'q.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

15.title: Sentence Race: if-sentences
15.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida tezkor musobaqa (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Type 2 va Type 3 gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: if-qismi oldin (vergul bilan) yoki keyin (vergulsiz).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z — birinchi; vergulli so'z — if-qismi tugaydigan joy; nuqta yoki '?' belgili so'z — oxirgi.
Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa qo'lini ko'taradi, gapni o'qiydi va Type 2 yoki Type 3 ekanini aytadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

16.title: Grammar Auction: during / while, if / unless
16.stage: during/while, if/unless tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
16.goal: during + ot va while + gap / V-ing farqini, if/unless dan keyin Present Simple (will emas) kelishini va unless dan keyin inkor qo'yilmasligini tekshirish, xato gapni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: during/while va if/unless to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'During I was eating' → 'While I was eating').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: During Navruz, my grandmother always cooks sumalak.
items.why: Navruz — bayram nomi (ot) → during + ot.

items.s: During I was eating, the waiter brought the bill.
items.fix: While I was eating, the waiter brought the bill.
items.why: Keyin gap keladi (I was eating) → while, during emas.

items.s: While I was cooking plov, my sister was setting the table.
items.why: While + gap: ega + was + V-ing.

items.why: dinner — ot → during; while dan keyin gap keladi.

items.s: If you add more salt, the soup will be too salty.
items.why: If + Present Simple, will + V1.

items.s: Unless you don't eat breakfast, you'll be hungry at school.
items.fix: Unless you eat breakfast, you'll be hungry at school.
items.why: unless = if … not; undan keyin yana inkor qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: We'll get a takeaway unless Mum cooks tonight.
items.why: unless + tasdiq, Present Simple (= if Mum doesn't cook).

items.s: If the café will be closed, we'll eat at home.
items.fix: If the café is closed, we'll eat at home.
items.why: if-gapda will ishlatilmaydi: If + Present Simple (is).

items.s: She burnt her finger while making samsa.
items.why: while + V-ing ham mumkin: while making.

items.s: The cake won't be sweet unless you will add sugar.
items.fix: The cake won't be sweet unless you add sugar.
items.why: unless + Present Simple, will emas.

16.goal: Gap boshini grammatik va mantiqan to'g'ri davom bilan ulash: during + ot, while + gap / V-ing, if/unless + Present Simple, will + V1.

16.title: Find someone who… eats a snack during the break
16.stage: Reading'dan oldin harakatli mashq sifatida (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
16.goal: during/while va if/unless bilan savol tuzish va javob berish (Do you … during …? Do you … while …? Will you … if …?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you eat a snack during the school break?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What do you eat? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni gap bilan aytadi: 'Aziz listens to music while cooking.'

17.title: Grammar Auction: Could you tell me where … is?
17.stage: Bilvosita savollar tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
17.goal: Bilvosita savollarda (Could you tell me… / Do you know… / I wonder…) so'z tartibini, do/does/did tushib qolishini va Yes/No savolda if/whether ishlatilishini tekshirish, xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ega fe'ldan oldinmi, do/does/did tushganmi, Yes/No savolda if/whether bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'where can I buy' → 'where I can buy').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Could you tell me where the gym is?
items.why: Bilvosita: ega (the gym) + fe'l (is).

items.s: Do you know when does the history test start?
items.fix: Do you know when the history test starts?
items.why: does tushib qoladi, fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: the test starts.

items.s: I wonder if the canteen is open today.
items.why: Yes/No savol → if; I wonder… oxirida nuqta.

items.s: Can you tell me what did the teacher say?
items.fix: Can you tell me what the teacher said?
items.why: did tushib qoladi, fe'l V2 ga o'tadi: said.

items.s: Do you know whose backpack this is?
items.why: whose + ot, keyin ega + fe'l: this is.

items.s: Could you tell me where can I buy a notebook?
items.fix: Could you tell me where I can buy a notebook?
items.why: can egadan keyin turadi: where I can buy.

items.s: Do you know is the library open on Saturday?
items.fix: Do you know if the library is open on Saturday?
items.why: Yes/No savol → if/whether + ega + fe'l.

items.s: Can you remember what the homework was?
items.why: O'tgan zamon: what + ega + was.

items.s: I wonder why is the teacher late today.
items.fix: I wonder why the teacher is late today.
items.why: I wonder + why + ega + fe'l (savol tartibi yo'q).

items.s: Do you know whether we need a calculator for the exam?
items.why: whether = if (Yes/No savol); tartib darak gapdek.

items.s: Could you tell me how much does the textbook cost?
items.fix: Could you tell me how much the textbook costs?
items.why: does tushadi, fe'lga -s: the textbook costs.

items.s: Do you know who teaches music this year?
items.why: who — ega; tartib o'zgarmaydi: who teaches.

17.title: Dominoes: direct → indirect questions
17.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: bevosita savol → bilvosita savol (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
17.goal: Bevosita savolni o'zining bilvosita shakli bilan ulash: ega + fe'l tartibi, does → fe'l-s, did → V2, can egadan keyin, Yes/No → if/whether.
rules: Har guruhga bitta domino to'plami bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida BEVOSITA savol bor — shu savolning BILVOSITA shakli qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.
Har ulashda o'quvchi nima o'zgarganini aytadi: ega fe'ldan oldin keldi, does/did tushdi, Yes/No → if/whether, oxirida '?' yoki '.'.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga, to'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

18.title: Grammar Auction: I wish I had / hadn't / could / would
18.stage: Wish jadvali (yangi mavzu) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
18.goal: wish + Past Simple / Past Continuous / Past Perfect / would / could / to V1 gaplarini to'g'ri va xatoga ajratish; xarid mavzusidagi gaplarda xatoni tuzatish (have → had, didn't buy → hadn't bought, can → could).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: wish dan keyingi shakl to'g'rimi? (hozir → Past Simple, o'tgan → Past Perfect, boshqa odam → would, qila olsam → could).
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikkan puli yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'I wish I have' → 'I wish I had').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I wish I have a credit card.
items.fix: I wish I had a credit card.
items.why: Hozirgi holat → wish + Past Simple: had.

items.s: I wish I hadn't lost the receipt.
items.why: O'tgan ishdan afsus → wish + Past Perfect: hadn't lost.

items.why: Boshqa odam o'zgarsin → wish + ega + would + V1.

items.why: O'tgan ish (last week) → Past Perfect: hadn't bought.

items.fix: I wish I could pay by card in this shop.
items.why: wish dan keyin can emas, could.

items.why: Qila olmayman → wish + could + V1.

items.s: I wish I would be richer.
items.fix: I wish I were richer.
items.why: O'zi haqida would ishlatilmaydi: I wish I were…

items.why: Hozirgi holat → Past Simple: weren't (3-shaxs: wishes).

items.why: Hozir bo'layotgan ish → wish + Past Continuous.

items.fix: I wish my sister would stop taking my clothes.
items.why: Boshqa odamdan norozilik → would + V1.

18.title: Board Game: I wish I had a bigger budget!

18.goal: Vaziyatni 'I wish…' gapiga aylantirish (Past Simple / Past Continuous / Past Perfect / would / could), xatoni tuzatish va xarid so'zlarini og'zaki ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'Make a wish' kataklarida vaziyatni to'liq 'I wish…' gapiga aylantiradi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: hozirgi holat → Past Simple (were), o'tgan → had + V3, boshqa odam → would, qila olmaslik → could. Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

18.title: Dominoes: shopping problems → I wish…
18.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: vaziyat → wish gapi (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
18.goal: Xarid vaziyatini mos wish gapi bilan ulash: hozirgi holat → Past Simple / were, o'tgan → had + V3, boshqa odam → would, qila olmaslik → could, rasmiy → wish to.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi vaziyatga mos 'I wish…' javobini boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping.
Har ulashda zamonni tekshiring: vaziyat hozirmi, o'tganmi yoki boshqa odam haqidami? Wish gapidagi shakl shunga mos bo'lishi kerak.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

18.title: Taboo: shopping words
18.stage: Shopping — CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
18.goal: Xarid so'zlarini (receipt, refund, discount, bargain, queue, fitting room…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish: ta'rif, sinonim, misol.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Bonus: tushuntiruvchi 'I wish…' gapini to'g'ri ishlatsa +1 (masalan, receipt uchun: 'I wish I hadn't lost it — now I can't get my money back').
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Find someone who… wishes he/she had more money
18.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq, Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
18.goal: 'Do you wish you had / were / could / hadn't…?' savollarini tuzish va javob berish; natijani 3-shaxsda aytish (He wishes he had…).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you wish you had more pocket money?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va qo'shimcha savol beradi: 'Why?' — javob to'liq gap bilan.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni 3-shaxsda aytadi: 'Aziz wishes he had more pocket money.'

18.goal: Xarid haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish va unda 'I wish…' (hozir, o'tgan, boshqa odam, could) gaplarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 1 ta 'I wish…' gapini ishlatadi.
Tinglovchi to'g'ri wish gaplarini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball. Wish dan keyin zamon xato bo'lsa (I wish I have…) ball berilmaydi.

18.title: Sentence Race: wish sentences
18.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida. Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
18.goal: wish gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: I wish + ega + had / hadn't + V3 / could / would / were.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: 'wish' dan keyin odatda ega + fe'l keladi (rasmiy 'wish to + V1' bundan mustasno).
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Jamoa gap nima haqida ekanini ham aytsa (hozir / o'tgan / boshqa odam / rasmiy xohish) yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.
