19.title: Grammar Auction: to / in order to / so as to / so that / for
19.stage: Maqsad infinitivi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Maqsad gaplarini to'g'ri va xatoga ajratish: to + V1, in order to, so as not to, so that + ega + can/could, for + ot; 'for to', 'for + V1', 'so that not to' kabi xatolarni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: maqsad to'g'ri ifodalanganmi? (fe'l oldidan — to, ot oldidan — for, gap oldidan — so that).
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikkan puli yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'for to buy' → 'to buy').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I went to the bank to get some cash.
items.why: Maqsad + fe'l → to + V1 (to get).

items.s: I went to the shop for to buy some bread.

items.why: 'for to' hech qachon ishlatilmaydi: to buy.

items.s: She studies hard in order to pass her exams.
items.why: in order to + V1 — rasmiyroq maqsad.

items.why: Ot (fruit) oldidan for: for + ot.

items.s: I called my friend for asking about the homework.
items.fix: I called my friend to ask about the homework.
items.why: Odam maqsadi → to + V1, 'for + -ing' emas.

items.why: Inkor maqsad: so as not to + V1.

items.s: We went to the market in order buy some melons.
items.fix: We went to the market in order to buy some melons.
items.why: in order to — 'to' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: I saved money so that I could to buy a phone.
items.fix: I saved money so that I could buy a phone.
items.why: could dan keyin to qo'yilmaydi: could buy.

items.s: My dad works hard so that we can have a better life.
items.why: so that + ega + can + V1.

items.s: Ulugh Beg built an observatory to study the stars.
items.why: Maqsad: to + V1 (to study).

19.title: Board Game: Why? — To…! (purpose + confusing words)
19.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin — og'zaki mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Maqsadni to + V1 / in order to / so as not to / so that / for + ot bilan og'zaki aytish va chalkash so'zlarni (than/then, quiet/quite, advice/advise…) to'g'ri tanlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: maqsad gapini to'liq aytadi yoki 'Choose' katagida chalkash so'zlardan to'g'risini tanlab, butun gapni o'qiydi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: fe'l oldidan — to, ot oldidan — for, gap oldidan — so that. Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Choose: dessert / desert — Ice cream is my favourite ___.

squares.t: Give 2 reasons why you use your phone (to + verb).
squares.a: e.g. I use it to call my friends and to watch videos.

squares.a: affect

squares.a: I whispered in order not to wake the baby.

squares.a: lend

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: why do you come to Jony Academy? Use to / in order to / so that.

19.title: Dominoes: action → purpose
19.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: harakat → maqsad (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Harakatni mos maqsad bilan ulash: to + V1, in order to, so as not to, so that + ega + can/could/don't/wouldn't, for + ot.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi harakatga mos maqsadni ('to…', 'so that…', 'for…') boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping.
Har ulashda savol bering: 'Why?' — javob mantiqan ham, grammatik jihatdan ham to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: My brother goes to the pool
to learn to swim.
I use a dictionary
to check new words.
I went to the chemist's
for some medicine.
She called the hotel
to book a room.
We whispered
so as not to wake the baby.
My mum went to the bank
to get some cash.
Ulugh Beg built an observatory
to study the stars.
Put on a warm coat
so as not to catch a cold.
Take a map with you
so that you don't get lost.
I set two alarms
so that I wouldn't oversleep.
Speak louder
so that everyone can hear you.
They went to the stadium
to watch the football match.
I opened the window
to let some fresh air in.
Tourists come to Samarkand
in order to see the Registan.

19.title: Taboo: confusing words
19.stage: Confusing words — CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Chalkash so'zlarni (dessert/desert, lose/loose, borrow/lend, piece/peace…) inglizcha tushuntirish va juftidan farqlash.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa so'zni topsa +1 ball. So'zni to'g'ri harflab ham aytsa (dessert: d-e-s-s-e-r-t) yana +1 — chalkash juftidan farqlash uchun.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi. Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Bonus: tushuntiruvchi maqsad shaklini ishlatsa +1 (masalan: 'You use it to…', 'People go there in order to…').
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.title: Find someone who… learns English to study abroad
19.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq, Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Maqsad shakli bor savollarni tuzish (Do you… to / in order to / so as not to / so that…?) va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Are you learning English in order to study abroad?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va qo'shimcha savol beradi: 'Why?' yoki 'What for?' — javob to + V1 bilan.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytadi: 'Lola uses an app to learn new words.'

19.title: Speaking cards: Why do you do it?
19.stage: Sinf mashqi 4 'Nega?' (speaking) bilan birga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: 'Why…?' savollariga 3–4 gapli javob berish: to + V1, in order to, so as not to, so that + can, for + ot shakllarini aralashtirib ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 xil maqsad shaklini ishlatadi (masalan: to…, so that I can…).
Tinglovchi to'g'ri maqsad shakllarini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball. 'for to' yoki 'for + fe'l' eshitilsa — ball berilmaydi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

19.title: Sentence Race: purpose sentences
19.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida. Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Maqsad gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: harakat + to / in order to / so as not to / so that + ega + can/could.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: avval harakat, keyin maqsad (to…, so that…). Inkorda 'not' — 'to' dan OLDIN: so as not to, in order not to.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Jamoa gapdagi maqsad shaklini boshqasiga almashtirib aytsa (to → in order to) yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: He went to the gym to work out.
I saved money so that I could buy a laptop.
She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
We whispered so as not to wake the baby.
I went to the shop for some bread.
Tourists visit Samarkand to see the Registan.

Take a warm coat so that you don't catch a cold.
Can you lend me your pen to write this down?
My dad works hard so that we can have a good life.

19.title: Quiz Board: to, for, so that — and confusing words
19.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
19.goal: Maqsad infinitivi shakllari, xato tuzatish va chalkash so'zlarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Confusing words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

20.title: Grammar Auction: must, have to, should
20.stage: Yangi mavzu (modal fe'llar) tushuntirilgandan keyin, CORE lug'atdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: must / mustn't / have to / don't have to / needn't / should / had to to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: modal fe'l shakli va ma'nosi to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: don't must → mustn't; must to go → must go).
Ma'no xatosiga alohida e'tibor: mustn't = TAQIQ, don't have to / needn't = SHART EMAS. Ustoz javob kalitidagi izohni o'qib beradi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Tenants have to pay the rent on the first day of the month.
items.why: Tenants — ko'plik: have to + V1.

items.s: You don't must smoke in the hallway.
items.fix: You mustn't smoke in the hallway.
items.why: must inkori — mustn't; 'don't must' degan shakl yo'q.

items.s: I must to lock the door before I leave.
items.fix: I must lock the door before I leave.
items.why: must + V1: 'to' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: She doesn't have to pay a deposit for this flat.
items.why: Shart emas → doesn't have to + V1 (she → does).

items.s: He has to not clean the attic today.
items.fix: He doesn't have to clean the attic today.
items.why: have to inkori do/does bilan yasaladi: doesn't have to.

items.s: You should call the landlord about the broken window.
items.why: Maslahat → should + V1.

items.s: Do we must take off our shoes in the house?
items.fix: Do we have to take off our shoes in the house?
items.why: Savol: Do we have to…? yoki Must we…? — must do/does bilan ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Children mustn't play on the staircase.
items.why: Taqiq (mumkin emas) → mustn't + V1.

items.s: Last year we must paint the whole flat ourselves.
items.fix: Last year we had to paint the whole flat ourselves.
items.why: must ning o'tgan shakli yo'q: o'tgan zamonda had to.

items.s: You needn't bring anything — we have everything.
items.why: needn't + V1 = shart emas (to qo'yilmaydi).

items.s: It's Sunday, so we mustn't get up early.
items.fix: It's Sunday, so we don't have to get up early.
items.why: Ma'no: bu taqiq emas, ixtiyoriy → don't have to (yoki needn't).

items.s: You shouldn't leave the windows open when it rains.
items.why: shouldn't + V1 = qilmagan ma'qul (maslahat).

20.title: Board Game: House Rules
20.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin — og'zaki mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: Modal fe'llar bilan og'zaki gap tuzish (qoida, taqiq, maslahat, o'tgan va kelajak majburiyat) va uy-bino so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi (must / have to / should …).
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Correct' kataklarida xatoni topib, butun gapni to'g'ri aytish kerak; 'Talk' kataklarida — kamida 2 ta modal fe'l.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.a: Do you have to work on Saturdays? (or: Must you work on Saturdays?)

squares.a: e.g. You should meet your neighbours.

squares.a: mustn't = it is not allowed; don't have to = it is not necessary.

squares.a: e.g. They mustn't play on the balcony. They must be careful on the stairs.

squares.t: What did you have to do at home last weekend?
squares.a: e.g. I had to clean my room and help my mum.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: your dream house. What should it have?
squares.a: e.g. It should have a big balcony and a rooftop garden.

20.title: Dominoes: problems at home — what should we do?
20.stage: Kombinatsiya yoki sinf mashqlari boshida: modal fe'l + uy so'zlari (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: Uydagi vaziyat haqidagi modal fe'lli gap boshini (have to, must, should, need to, had to, needn't) mantiqiy davomi bilan, savolni esa javobi bilan ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshini qaysi toshning chap tomoni mantiqan va grammatik to'g'ri davom ettiradi — toping.
Maslahat: modal fe'ldan keyin V1 keladi (must repair, have to use), 'to' faqat have to / need to da bo'ladi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.

pairs: The lift is broken, so we have to
use the stairs today.

take a hat and some water.

repair the roof before it rains again.

on time every month.

buy a ticket for your car.

on the staircase — it's dangerous.

put a new light down there.

live near the airport.

20.title: Taboo: home and buildings
20.stage: Home and buildings — CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: Uy va bino so'zlarini (landlord, tenant, attic, basement, skyscraper …) inglizcha tushuntirib berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (kartani jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda modal fe'l ishlatsa yaxshi: 'Tenants have to give it to the landlord' (rent), 'You mustn't …'.

20.title: Find someone who… has to share a bedroom
20.stage: Reading'dan oldin harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: have to / need to / should bilan savol tuzish (Do you have to…? Did you have to…? Will you have to…?) va uydagi hayot haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzadi: '…has to…' → 'Do you have to…?', '…had to…' → 'Did you have to…?'.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? How often?). 'doesn't have to' qatorida 'No' javobi kerak.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; savol faqat inglizcha beriladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi (Aziz has to…).

20.title: Speaking cards: rules and advice at home
20.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa o'rniga: 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
20.goal: Uy, qoidalar va maslahat haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; har javobda kamida 2 ta modal fe'l (have to, must, mustn't, should, don't have to).

20.goal: Modal fe'lli gapda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: darak, inkor (mustn't, doesn't have to) va savol (Do we have to…? Should I…?).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.

21.title: Grammar Auction: is spoken, was born, will be built
21.stage: Yangi mavzu (be + V3) tushuntirilgandan keyin, CORE lug'atdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
21.goal: Present / Past / Future Simple Passive (am/is/are, was/were, will be + V3) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya tekshiradi: be bormi, zamoni to'g'rimi, V3 to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: was wrote → was written; He born → He was born).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

21.title: Dominoes: active → passive
21.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: active gapni passive bilan ulash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
21.goal: Active gapni uning to'g'ri passive shakli bilan ulash: zamonni saqlash (build → is built, built → was built, will build → will be built).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ACTIVE gapning PASSIVE shakli qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping.
Diqqat: zamon saqlanadi! 'They build…' → 'are built', 'They built…' → 'were built', 'They will build…' → 'will be built'.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.

22.goal: Continuous passive (am/is/are/was/were + being + V3) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilganini ajratish: 'been' emas 'being', being dan keyin V3, was/were mosligi, 'will be being' xatosi. Gaplar pul mavzusida.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'is been repaired' → 'is being repaired').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

22.title: Dominoes: active → continuous passive
22.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida, sinf mashqi 3 (Active → Passive) oldidan (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
22.goal: Active gapni passive'ga aylantirish: are printing → are being printed, was counting → was being counted; Simple (are printed) va Continuous (are being printed) farqini ko'rish.
rules: Juftlik yoki 3 kishilik guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida ACTIVE gap bor — shu gapning PASSIVE shakli qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping.
Zamonga e'tibor bering: are printing → are being printed, were printing → were being printed, print every year → are printed (Simple).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

22.title: Find someone who… (what is being done?)
22.stage: Reading'dan oldin harakatli mashq sifatida (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
22.goal: Continuous passive bilan savol tuzish (Is your phone being fixed…? Was dinner being cooked…?) va uni Simple passive savoldan (Are you given…?) farqlash.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi: Is/Are/Was/Were + ega + being + V3? (masalan: Is your phone being fixed at the moment?).
Diqqat: 'every week' qatori — Simple Passive savol (Are you given pocket money every week?), 'being' kerak emas.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where? Why? Who by?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 natijani passive bilan aytib beradi (Aziz's phone is being fixed.).

23.title: Grammar Auction: has been closed, had been built
23.stage: Yangi mavzu (perfect passive) jadvalidan keyin, kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
23.goal: Perfect passive (have/has/had/will have + been + V3) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilganini ajratish: 'been' tushib qolishi, V3, has/have mosligi, 'will has' xatosi. Gaplar yo'l mavzusida.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: has/have/had/will have bormi, keyin 'been' turibdimi, oxirida V3 to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'had built' → 'had been built').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? Who by?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 natijani passive bilan aytib beradi (Lola has been given a lift by a neighbour.).

23.goal: Yo'l, transport va shahardagi o'zgarishlar haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; javobda perfect passive (has been / had been / will have been + V3) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 1 ta perfect passive ishlatadi (masalan: A new bridge has been built near my house).
Tinglovchi to'g'ri perfect passive gaplarni sanaydi: har biri +1 ball; darsdagi yo'l so'zi (traffic jam, detour, flat tyre…) ishlatilsa yana +1.

23.title: Sentence Race: perfect passive sentences

23.goal: Perfect passive gapda so'z tartibini tuzish: ega + has/have/had/will have + been + V3; savol (Has the tyre been…?) va inkor (hasn't been) tartibi.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi bor so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus: gapning zamonini aytsa (Present / Past / Future Perfect Passive) yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

24.title: Grammar Auction: bored or boring?
24.stage: YANGI MAVZU (-ed / -ing) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
24.goal: -ed (his: I'm bored) va -ing (xususiyat: the trip is boring) sifatlarini hamda predloglarni (interested in, tired of, frightened of) to'g'ri/xato ishlatilganini ajratish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: sifat -ed yoki -ing shaklida to'g'ri turibdimi, predlog to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin sababini aytishi shart: 'odamning hissi → -ed' yoki 'narsa qanday → -ing'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The coach journey to Samarkand was really tiring.
items.why: Safar QANDAY (charchatadi) → -ing: tiring.

items.s: I was very boring on the long train journey.
items.fix: I was very bored on the long train journey.
items.why: Men nima HIS qildim → -ed: bored. 'I was boring' = men zerikarli odam edim.

items.s: I'm interested in old trains and trams.
items.why: Qiziqish — mening hissim → interested + in.

items.s: The new metro stations are amazed.
items.fix: The new metro stations are amazing.
items.why: Stansiyalar QANDAY (hayratga soladi) → -ing: amazing.

items.s: We were surprised by the low taxi fare.
items.why: Biz his qildik → surprised by.

items.s: My little sister is frightening of planes.
items.fix: My little sister is frightened of planes.
items.why: Uning hissi (qo'rqadi) → -ed: frightened of.

items.s: It was an excited ride on the high-speed train.
items.fix: It was an exciting ride on the high-speed train.
items.why: Ot oldida narsaning xususiyati → -ing: an exciting ride.

items.s: The passengers were annoyed because the flight was delayed.
items.why: Yo'lovchilar his qildi → annoyed; delayed — kechikkan.

items.s: I'm tired of waiting for the bus every morning.
items.why: tired of — …dan charchamoq, bezor bo'lmoq.

items.s: The new bus route is very confused.
items.fix: The new bus route is very confusing.
items.why: Yo'nalish QANDAY (chalkashtiradi) → -ing: confusing.

items.s: My brother is very interested about electric cars.
items.fix: My brother is very interested in electric cars.
items.why: interested + in (about emas).

items.s: Cycling to school in spring is really relaxing.
items.why: Velosipedda yurish QANDAY → -ing: relaxing.

24.goal: -ed / -ing juftlarini (bored/boring, tired/tiring…) va predloglarni og'zaki ishlatish; transport haqida gapirish.

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi yoki ikkala shaklni aytadi (masalan: bored / boring).
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi (ustozdagi javoblar varag'i bo'yicha); shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida 1 ta -ed hamda 1 ta -ing sifat ishlatadi.

FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

24.title: Dominoes: How did you feel? What was it like?
24.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: -ed / -ing va predloglarni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
24.goal: Savol va javobni ulash: 'How did you feel…?' → -ed javob (Frightened!), 'What was … like?' → -ing javob (Relaxing!); gap boshini to'g'ri predlog bilan davom ettirish (interested in, tired of…).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savol yoki gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomoniga mos kelishini toping.
Maslahat: 'How did/do you feel…?' savoliga -ed sifat bilan, 'What was/is … like?' savoliga -ing sifat bilan javob beriladi; interested → in, tired → of.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Bonus: tushuntirishda -ed / -ing sifat ishlatsa (masalan: 'It is exciting', 'People feel bored') — +1 qo'shimcha ball.

25.title: Grammar Auction: myself, themselves, each other
25.stage: YANGI MAVZU (o'zlik olmoshlari) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zlik olmoshlari (myself…themselves), by + self, each other va kurs grammatikasidagi (Past Simple, Type 2, Passive, bilvosita savol) to'g'ri va xato gaplarni ajratish hamda tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? (o'zlik olmoshi, each other yoki kurs grammatikasi)
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'theirselves' → 'themselves').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: She taught herself to play the dutar.
items.why: she → herself: ega va ob'ekt bir odam.

items.s: I hurt me when I fell off my bike.
items.fix: I hurt myself when I fell off my bike.
items.why: Ega va ob'ekt bir odam (I … I) → myself.

items.s: They enjoyed themselves at the wedding.
items.why: enjoy + o'zlik olmoshi: they → themselves (maza qilishdi).

items.s: The boys helped theirselves to plov.
items.fix: The boys helped themselves to plov.
items.why: 'theirselves' degan so'z yo'q → themselves.

items.s: Aziz and Lola help each other with their homework.
items.why: Biri ikkinchisiga yordam beradi → each other.

items.s: I feel myself tired after the test.
items.fix: I feel tired after the test.
items.why: feel'dan keyin o'zlik olmoshi ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: My grandfather lives by himself in Bukhara.
items.why: by + himself = yolg'iz.

items.s: My best friend and I phone ourselves every evening.
items.fix: My best friend and I phone each other every evening.
items.why: Biri ikkinchisiga qo'ng'iroq qiladi → each other.

items.s: I have visited Samarkand last summer.
items.fix: I visited Samarkand last summer.
items.why: Takror: aniq o'tgan vaqt (last summer) → Past Simple.

items.s: If I were rich, I would buy my parents a house.
items.why: Takror, Type 2: If + were, would + V1.

items.s: The new school in our street was built in 2020.
items.why: Takror, Passive: was + V3 (built).

items.s: Could you tell me where is the station?
items.fix: Could you tell me where the station is?
items.why: Takror, bilvosita savol: ega + fe'l (the station is).

25.title: Board Game: myself and the IELTS 2.0 course
25.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Kurs takrori' mashqlari (3–4) o'rniga (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zlik olmoshlari, by + self, each other va IELTS 2.0 grammatikasini (Present Perfect, since/for, Type 2, Passive, Wish, Future Perfect, bilvosita savol) og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: shaklni aytadi yoki to'liq gap tuzadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi (ustozdagi javoblar varag'i bo'yicha); shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida 1 ta o'zlik olmoshi (myself, by myself…) ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Say the reflexive pronoun: I → ?
squares.a: myself

squares.t: Say the reflexive pronoun: they → ?
squares.a: themselves

squares.t: Say the reflexive pronouns: he, she, it
squares.a: himself, herself, itself

squares.t: Finish: I taught ___ to ride a bike.
squares.a: myself

squares.t: Say the plural: yourself → ?
squares.a: yourselves

squares.t: Correct: I cut me while I was cooking.
squares.a: I cut myself while I was cooking.

squares.t: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I ___ (see) this film yesterday.
squares.a: saw

squares.t: Choose: Aziz and Lola phoned (themselves / each other) last night.
squares.a: each other

squares.t: Say it with 'by + self': My grandma lives alone.
squares.a: My grandma lives by herself.

squares.t: Since or for? I have studied English ___ two years.
squares.a: for

squares.t: Correct: They enjoyed theirselves.
squares.a: They enjoyed themselves.

squares.t: Say the comparative and the superlative: good
squares.a: better, the best

squares.t: What do you say to a guest at your table? Use 'help'.
squares.a: Help yourself!

squares.t: Finish: If I ___ (be) a pilot, I would fly to Japan.
squares.a: were (was is also OK in speech)

squares.t: Make it passive: They built this school in 2015.
squares.a: This school was built in 2015.

squares.t: Correct: I feel myself happy today.
squares.a: I feel happy today.

squares.t: Finish: By 2030, I ___ (finish) university.
squares.a: will have finished

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: something you taught yourself.
squares.a: e.g. I taught myself to cook plov.

squares.t: Choose: I wish I (have / had) more free time.
squares.a: had

squares.t: Make it indirect: Where is the bank? → Could you tell me …?
squares.a: Could you tell me where the bank is?

squares.t: Finish with a purpose: I study English ___ get a good job.
squares.a: to / in order to / so as to

squares.t: Yet or already? I haven't finished my homework ___.
squares.a: yet

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'each other' about you and your best friend.
squares.a: e.g. We help each other with homework.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: what have you learned in IELTS 2.0? Use 'myself'.
squares.a: e.g. I have taught myself many new words, and I'm proud of myself.

25.title: Dominoes: myself, each other and course revision
25.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: o'zlik olmoshlari va kurs zamonlari (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: Gap boshini mos davom bilan ulash: ega ↔ o'zlik olmoshi (I → myself, children → yourselves), each other, hamda kurs grammatikasi (Type 3, Past Perfect, since, wish, bilvosita savol, maqsad, unless).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomoniga mos kelishini toping.
Maslahat: o'zlik olmoshi egaga mos bo'lishi shart (Ali → yourself, children → yourselves, the cat → itself); zamon ham mos bo'lsin.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: I taught
myself to cook plov from videos.
If I had studied harder,
I would have passed the exam.
Be careful with the knife, Ali! Don't cut
yourself — it's very sharp.
By the time we got to the cinema,
the film had already started.
My grandfather lives by
himself in Khiva, but we often visit him.
I have lived in Tashkent
since I was five years old.
She looked at
herself in the mirror and smiled.
I wish I
had more free time.
The cat is washing
itself in the sun.
Could you tell me where
the nearest metro station is?
We painted the whole room
ourselves — no one helped us.
I always leave home early
so as not to be late for school.
Children, enjoy
yourselves at the party!
Unless you hurry,
you will miss the bus.
Ibn Sina and Beruni wrote letters to
each other about science.

25.title: Taboo: IELTS 2.0 top words
25.stage: Revision CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin yoki dars oxirida yakuniy takror (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: Kurs davomida o'rganilgan eng muhim so'zlarni (anniversary, prescription, witness, destination, salary, drought, polymath…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi (kartani jamoasiga ko'rsatmaydi).
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Bonus: jamoa so'z qaysi darsda o'tilganini (mavzusini) ham topsa — +1 qo'shimcha ball.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

25.title: Find someone who… taught himself or herself to swim
25.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zlik olmoshi va each other bilan savol tuzish (Did you teach yourself…? Do you and your friend help each other…?) hamda kurs zamonlarida savol berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi. Diqqat: himself/herself savolda 'yourself'ga aylanadi (Did you teach yourself to swim?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? / How?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (Lola taught herself to swim.).

items.t: …taught himself/herself to swim.
items.q: Did you teach yourself to swim?

items.t: …enjoyed himself/herself at a wedding this year.
items.q: Did you enjoy yourself at a wedding this year?

items.t: …has cut himself/herself while cooking.
items.q: Have you ever cut yourself while cooking?

items.t: …sometimes talks to himself/herself.
items.q: Do you sometimes talk to yourself?

items.t: …would like to live by himself/herself one day.
items.q: Would you like to live by yourself one day?

items.t: …studies with a friend so they can help each other.
items.q: Do you study with a friend so you can help each other?

items.t: …has already finished today's homework.
items.q: Have you already finished today's homework?

items.t: …has been studying English for more than two years.
items.q: Have you been studying English for more than two years?

items.t: …would travel to Japan if he/she had a lot of money.
items.q: Would you travel to Japan if you had a lot of money?

items.t: …wishes he/she had more free time.
items.q: Do you wish you had more free time?

items.t: …was born in a different city.
items.q: Were you born in a different city?

items.t: …is proud of himself/herself after this course.
items.q: Are you proud of yourself after this course?

25.title: Speaking cards: I did it myself!
25.stage: Listening'dan keyin, dars oxirida gapirish yoki 'Men o'zim' mashqi o'rniga (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zi, o'qishi va kurs haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; o'zlik olmoshlari, by myself, each other va kurs zamonlarini (Present Perfect, Past Perfect, Wish, Future Perfect) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 1 ta o'zlik olmoshi (myself, by myself, yourself…) yoki each other ishlatadi.
Tinglovchi to'g'ri ishlatilgan har bir o'zlik olmoshi uchun +1 ball beradi; xato bo'lsa (theirselves, I feel myself…) — to'g'rilab aytadi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What have you taught yourself to do? How did you learn it?
Do you prefer to study by yourself or with friends? Why?
What do you do to enjoy yourself at the weekend?

What do you and your best friend do for each other?

Had you studied English before you started this course? Where and how?
By the end of next year, what will you have achieved?

25.title: Sentence Race: reflexives and course revision
25.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror yoki mashqni tez tugatganlar uchun (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zlik olmoshi, by + self, each other va kurs grammatikasi (Present Perfect, Type 2, Passive, bilvosita savol) gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga kesib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling. Har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta/so'roq belgisi — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa gapni o'qib beradi, +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi grammatikani aytib bersa (masalan: bilvosita savolda ega fe'ldan oldin keladi).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: She taught herself to play the piano.
My grandfather has lived by himself since 2020.
Did you enjoy yourselves at the party?
Last weekend we painted the kitchen ourselves.
The two friends always help each other.
Please help yourself to some more plov.
If I had free time, I would teach myself Korean.
Could you tell me where the bus station is?
This school was built in 2019.
I have been studying English for two years.

25.title: Quiz Board: IELTS 2.0 final revision
25.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida — kursning yakuniy takrori (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
25.goal: O'zlik olmoshlari, kurs grammatikasidagi tipik xatolar va 1–25-darslarning eng muhim so'zlarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 400').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.
